calibration_selection: one TRAIN identity per class plus 24 hash-ranked remaining TRAIN identities
augmentation_randomness: seed, epoch, original relative image identity; independent of arm/workers
head: inherited 160->1000
stem: DW3x3 s1 -> PW1x1 16 -> original BN -> ReLU6; no intermediate activation
stem_init: per-input-channel rank-1 SVD approximation; explicitly lossy
hf_init: zero learnable PW columns; DW copied from corresponding LL
channel_score: mean absolute activation immediately before projection times projection column L1 norm
channel_calibration_parent: uncompressed pretrained RGB; eval mode; once for all arms
channel_rule: first two actual MBConv untouched; remaining nearest multiple of 8 to 2/3, ties half-up; stable index tie break
compressed_rgb: same pruned backbone and pretrained head; original RGB stride2 stem; reuse only exact match
checkpoint_selection: lowest complete dev CE; first occurrence on exact tie; separate from early-stop improvement threshold
additional_seeds: only dev-best 1-2 wavelet arms after all four round1 outcomes; matched compressed RGB seeds
test_policy: freeze before official val / V2 MatchedFrequency; historical reuse disclosed; no feedback into selection
int8_calibration: same fixed 1024 TRAIN identities only; quantization recipe frozen before test
confidence_interval: paired image bootstrap; seeds averaged within image; seed variation separately reported
renode: optional fixed CPU/compiler/options/operator library and validated outputs; instructions not cycles/latency/energy
